design: All arms rank128. Task PCA from144original training slots; natural PCA from768discovery states; mixed PCA minimizes equal-domain mean squared error with equal-domain center. Anchor arms constrain inclusion of frozen nounrank1 and use127leading directions of training data projected orthogonal to it. Center-swap diagnostics use oldtaskcenter with unchanged natural/mixed bases. Freeze before evaluation.
evaluation: All old original-six non-discovery context states, retaining native failures as diagnostic; all80 H1002states with native-gate eligibility; all256 H998confirmation states from64documents, fourpositions each. No original whole-task holdouts evaluated.
metrics: KL(native || reconstructed), native-top1 agreement, centered squared-error ratio. Macro average old native-passing cohorts and natural documents. Natural top1 agreement is fidelity, not ground-truth accuracy.
limits: Dense PCA geometry, not sparse features. Mixed objective equalizes domain sample counts, not activation energies. All arms rank128; own-domain centers differ except explicit old-center diagnostics. Natural confirmation reused for development; no final-test claim. Reconstruction denominator uses fixed oldtaskcenter for comparability.
